banned.why: Disease claim - anxiety is a diagnosable condition; use structure/function language like 'supports calm' instead.

banned.claim: Treats or fixes PMS / relieves PMS symptoms.
banned.why: Disease/condition claim - reframe as 'supports emotional balance during your cycle'; testimonials implying PMS treatment are treated as disease claims.

banned.claim: Relieves back pain or works as a pain reliever.
banned.why: Disease claim implied by the Maya testimonial - cannot run testimonials that imply treatment of a medical symptom.

banned.claim: Anxiety relief within minutes / feel calmer within 60 minutes as a guaranteed outcome.
banned.why: Guaranteed result plus specific timeline to a health outcome - both banned for this category.

banned.claim: Clinically proven to reduce anxiety or improve sleep.
banned.why: 'Clinically proven' requires a cited study; Venetron references must stay qualified ('may help') and not be stated as proof for the finished product.

banned.claim: A safe replacement for antidepressants or anti-anxiety medication.
banned.why: Disease-treatment and drug-substitute claim - the site itself says consult a physician before mixing with such medications.
